rows.label: tlk001201_08_msg0001
rows.name:
An attack from the heavens is
raining down upon Alst...

rows.label: tlk001201_08_msg0002
rows.name:
Fortunately, Luxuria has been
spared, but Metsu is trying to
destroy Alst, isn't he?

rows.label: tlk001201_08_msg0003
rows.name:
We can neither defend against
the Devices nor stop them.

rows.label: tlk001201_08_msg0004
rows.name:
We have no choice but to leave this
to you... Alst's future is in
your hands.
